salons.name: John Salon KKD
salons.tagline: Kakinada's Premier Luxury Hair & Grooming Lounge
salons.description: John Salon KKD is Kakinada’s premier sanctuary for elevated hair artistry, precision beard sculpting, rejuvenating hair spas, and AI-guided style discovery. We blend master craft techniques with contemporary aesthetic care for an unforgettable grooming experience.
salons.address: Cinema Hall Road, opposite CNC Theatre

services.name: Signature Bespoke Haircut & Styling
services.description: Comprehensive consultation, invigorating scalp wash, precision shears cut, razor neck trim, and modern blow-dry finish.
services.preparation: Arrive 5 minutes prior to appointment with unwashed hair if possible for cut texture evaluation.
services.aftercare: Use sulfate-free shampoo and texturizing matte clay to preserve style shape.

services.name: Executive Fade & Beard Sculpting
services.description: Seamless low, mid, or taper fade paired with sharp razor beard shaping, hot towel treatment, and nourishing argan beard elixir.
services.preparation: Allow beard to grow at least 3-4 days before appointment for precision edge lineup.
services.aftercare: Apply 3-4 drops of argan beard oil daily and brush with boar-bristle brush.

services.name: Royal Moroccan Hair Spa & Scalp Detox
services.description: Deep detoxifying scalp massage with micro-mist steam infusion, botanical keratin cream mask, and pressure-point relaxation.
benefits: Eliminates scalp product residue and dandruff
services.preparation: Wear comfortable collarless clothing for neck and shoulder relaxation massage.
services.aftercare: Wait at least 24 hours before your next hair wash to lock in botanical argan oils.

services.name: Keratin Smoothing & Hair Botox Treatment
services.description: Intense frizz control and deep fiber restoration delivering silky, mirror-shine, manageable hair for months.
benefits: Cuts morning blow-dry time in half
services.preparation: Expect approximately 2 to 2.5 hours in the salon chair for deep thermal infusion.
services.aftercare: Do not wash, tie, or pin hair for 48 hours following treatment. Use salt-free shampoo.

services.name: D-Tan Glow Facial & Skin Rejuvenation
services.description: Instant tan removal scrub, brightening enzymatic masque, botanical antioxidant serum, and cooling ice-roller massage.
services.preparation: Avoid shaving right before treatment if you have easily irritated skin.
services.aftercare: Apply broad-spectrum sunscreen and avoid direct sun exposure for 12 hours.

services.name: Global Hair Color & Balayage Highlights
services.description: Hand-painted dimensional highlights or rich global shade using ammonia-free salon formulations for luminous gloss.
benefits: Zero scalp irritation or ammonia odor
services.preparation: Bring reference inspiration photos. Hair should be clean and product-free.
services.aftercare: Wash with color-protect shampoo in lukewarm or cool water.

services.name: Charcoal Beard Detox & Hot Towel Shave
services.description: Classic barber straight-razor shave with warm lather, activated charcoal exfoliation, and chilled mint aftershave splash.
benefits: Prevents razor burn and razor bumps
services.preparation: Inform your barber of skin sensitivities, moles, or scar tissue.
services.aftercare: Moisturize skin with non-comedogenic aloe balm.

services.name: Groom / Special Occasion Luxury Makeover
services.description: Complete elite package: Master haircut, beard sculpting, gold facial, hair spa, and bespoke party hair styling.
services.preparation: Book at least 1-2 days before wedding event or festive occasion.
services.aftercare: Keep hair dry and styled with flexible-hold setting spray provided.

services.name: Hydra-Dew Botanical Radiance Facial
services.description: Multi-step skin hydration therapy featuring gentle botanical enzymatic peel, micro-mist botanical steam, hyaluronic acid infusion, and chilled jade-roller lymphatic drainage.
services.preparation: Arrive 10 minutes early to unwind in our relaxation lounge. Avoid abrasive home scrubs 24 hours prior.
services.aftercare: Refrain from heavy makeup for 6-8 hours. Apply sunscreen daily and drink ample herbal water.

services.name: 24K Gold Peptide Anti-Aging Rejuvenation
services.description: Luxurious anti-aging treatment combining bio-active marine collagen ampoules, 24-karat gold peptide foil mask, and micro-current skin contouring for firmer skin.
services.preparation: Inform your esthetician of any sensitive skin conditions or allergies beforehand.
services.aftercare: Leave the nourishing peptide veil on skin overnight. Avoid steam rooms or saunas for 24 hours.

services.name: Vitamin C Cellular Brightening Facial
services.description: Concentrated antioxidant therapy utilizing stabilized L-ascorbic acid, citrus botanical peel, and cooling cryo-globe massage to reverse UV pigmentation and sun damage.
services.preparation: Discontinue retinol or strong AHA/BHA chemical peels 48 hours prior to treatment.
services.aftercare: Mandatory broad-spectrum SPF 50 application. Avoid harsh direct sunlight for 48 hours.

services.name: Aromatherapy Swedish Body Relaxation
services.description: Full-body restorative massage using warm pure essential oils (lavender, bergamot, sandalwood) with long rhythmic effleurage strokes to melt tension and improve sleep.
services.preparation: Avoid heavy meals 1 hour before massage. A warm shower before therapy is recommended.
services.aftercare: Drink warm water or herbal infusion. Allow botanical oils to absorb for 2 hours before showering.

services.name: Deep Tissue Therapeutic Muscle Release
services.description: Targeted deep myofascial release focusing on chronic neck tightness, shoulder strain, and lumbar fatigue utilizing warm botanical wintergreen balm.
benefits: Relieves desk and driving posture strain
services.preparation: Communicate pressure preferences and specific areas of discomfort clearly to your therapist.
services.aftercare: Mild muscle sensitivity is normal. Hydrate generously to flush out released toxins.

services.name: Ayurvedic Herbal Head & Shoulder Massage
services.description: Traditional Indian head massage utilizing warm brahmi and bhringraj herb-infused oils to relieve digital eye fatigue, tension headaches, and nourish roots.
benefits: Strengthens roots and combats hair thinning
Releases upper back and trapezius stiffness
services.preparation: Wear comfortable attire. Warm herbal oil will be massaged through hair and scalp.
services.aftercare: Retain oil in hair for at least 2 hours before washing with a gentle clarifying shampoo.

services.name: Royal Rose Luxury Spa Manicure
services.description: Deluxe hand grooming featuring wild rose petal soak, walnut shell cuticle buffing, warm shea butter hand masque, and precision nail shaping.
services.preparation: Remove existing gel or nail lacquer prior to appointment if possible.
services.aftercare: Apply cuticle oil daily and moisturize hands frequently with hand cream.

services.name: Moroccan Argan Pedicure & Heel Therapy
services.description: Intensive foot restoration with mineral sea salt soak, pumice heel buffing, argan sugar exfoliation, warm towel envelopment, and acupressure reflexology.
benefits: Relieves tired foot arches and swelling
Leaves feet velvety soft and refreshed
services.preparation: Wear open-toed footwear or loose trousers for comfort during the foot soak.
services.aftercare: Wear soft cotton socks overnight with moisturizer for maximum softness.

services.name: Full Body Botanical Polish & Glow Mask
services.description: Invigorating whole-body walnut, raw honey, and brown sugar polish followed by a warm kaolin clay cocoon wrap and soothing botanical body milk application.
services.preparation: Do not shave or wax within 24 hours prior to whole-body exfoliation.
services.aftercare: Avoid hot baths or swimming in chlorinated pools for 24 hours.

services.name: Velvet Waxing & Skin Calming Care
services.description: Gentle low-temperature strip wax treatment for arms and legs infused with zinc oxide, followed by chamomile and aloe-vera cooling spray.
services.preparation: Ensure hair length is at least 1/4 inch for optimal wax grip.
services.aftercare: Avoid hot showers, friction, and deodorants/perfumes on treated areas for 24 hours.

services.name: Pre-Bridal Radiance & Glow Ceremony
services.description: The ultimate 3-hour head-to-toe beauty ritual: 24K Gold Peptide Facial, Full Body Botanical Polish, Royal Rose Manicure & Argan Pedicure, and Ayurvedic Scalp Therapy.
services.preparation: Recommended 2-4 days prior to wedding or special occasion.
services.aftercare: Stay rested and hydrated; avoid trying unverified cosmetics before the ceremony.

offers.description: Enjoy 20% off your premier haircut or luxury grooming package at John Salon KKD.

offers.title: Weekday Spa & Glow Upgrade
offers.description: Get a flat ₹200 discount when combining our Royal Moroccan Hair Spa with any D-Tan Facial (Tue–Fri).

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Question:
Where is John Salon?

Answer:
John Salon is located on Cinema Hall Road, opposite CNC Theatre, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh.

Question:
What are the timings of John Salon?

Answer:
John Salon is open from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM and from 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM. The salon has a break from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

Question:
What is the starting price for hair styling?

Answer:
Hair styling starts from ₹250. The final price may vary depending on the selected hairstyle or service.

Question:
How long does hair styling take?

Answer:
Hair styling takes approximately 20–40 minutes depending on the selected hairstyle or service.

Question:
How can I contact John Salon?

Answer:
You can contact John Salon at 6303522044.

Can I book an appointment?

Customers can contact John Salon at 6303522044 for appointment enquiries. Availability must be confirmed directly with the salon.

John Salon Beauty Spa Official Guide, Treatments & Wellness Protocols:
1. Spa Philosophy & Suites: John Salon Beauty Spa at Bhanugudi Junction offers tranquil private therapy suites equipped with soundproofing, soft chromotherapy lighting, warm memory-foam massage tables, and botanical mist infusion.
2. Spa Facials & Skin Treatments: We provide Hydra-Dew Botanical Radiance Facial (₹950, 60 mins), 24K Gold Peptide Anti-Aging Rejuvenation (₹1,450, 75 mins), and Vitamin C Brightening Facial (₹1,100, 60 mins). All facials use dermatologically tested botanical elixirs, chilled jade or cryo-globes, and gentle enzyme exfoliation.
3. Therapeutic Massages: Our certified wellness therapists specialize in Aromatherapy Swedish Relaxation (₹1,600, 60 mins), Deep Tissue Therapeutic Muscle Release (₹1,900, 75 mins), and traditional Ayurvedic Herbal Head & Shoulder Massage (₹600, 35 mins). All body treatments use cold-pressed organic botanical oils.
4. Hand & Foot Nail Spa: Royal Rose Luxury Manicure (₹550, 45 mins) and Moroccan Argan Pedicure & Heel Therapy (₹750, 55 mins) feature sea salt mineral soaks, botanical scrubs, and pressure-point reflexology.
5. Pre-Bridal & Full Body Ceremonies: Pre-Bridal Radiance Ceremony (₹4,500, 180 mins) is a comprehensive head-to-toe ritual. Full Body Botanical Polish & Glow Mask (₹2,200, 90 mins) revitalizes dry or sun-damaged skin.
6. Preparation & Aftercare: Arrive 10 minutes before your scheduled appointment. Drink warm water after massages and avoid direct sun exposure without sunscreen for 24 hours following skin exfoliation.

salon_reviews.comment: Undoubtedly the best salon experience in Kakinada. The AI StyleScan recommended a textured side taper that looks fantastic. John cuts with world-class skill!
The Moroccan Hair Spa and facial left my hair and skin glowing. Very hygienic, polite staff, and the salon ambiance at Bhanugudi Junction is super premium.
Sharp beard line and modern fade. Booking through the web app was instant and didn’t have to wait in line at all. 10/10 recommend John Salon KKD.
